name: starflask_convert_image
description: Convert an image to another format via Starflask: png, jpeg, webp (default), gif, or svg (vectorize). Returns a job id immediately — poll with starflask_get_job until status is 'completed', then read result.image_url (or result.svg_url when target_format is "svg"). `image_url` is the source image — from starflask_upload_media or a prior job's result.image_url. (Sends job type image:convert for you; no model_key needed.)

image_url.description: URL of the source image to convert (from starflask_upload_media or a prior job's result.image_url).
